englishSource: Reading and pictures are ready. Narration and slides are still being made.
candidate: Ku hlaya ni swifaniso swi lunghekile. Nhlamuselo hi rito ni slides swa ha endliwa.
literalBacktranslation: Reading and pictures are ready. Spoken narration and slides are still being made.
semanticCheck: Keeps “reading” as the reading action/content rather than replacing it with texts/materials; says both reading and pictures are ready; and retains narration and slides as still in progress.
agreementCheck: The proposal uses plural concord (`swi` / `swa`) for each coordinated pair. That avoids explicitly making the singular “ku hlaya” the only subject, but I cannot verify from text-only inspection that this mixed infinitive-plus-plural coordination is natural Xitsonga. Have a first-language reviewer confirm concord and naturalness.
context: This tooltip is in the global staff-only readiness badge; it does not describe selected-language voice availability.
